verdict.rationale: Mistral documents open-weight models released under Apache 2.0, such as Mistral 7B and Mistral Small 4. Its docs index a model-weights page with download links, so users can inspect model artifacts under an open license. That covers weights rather than readable product source code, applies only to some models, and the pricing page says commercial deployments need a separate Mistral license. Missing for 10: evidence of source code (training/inference/platform/SDK) published under an open license, all models being openly licensed, a consistent licensing statement, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Open-weight models (e.g., Mistral 7B) are Apache 2.0 licensed for research/individual use
Open-source pre-trained and instruction-tuned models with various licenses, download links, and usage guidelines
Open-weight, general-purpose, flagship multimodal and multilingual model
